description: Sections 6/16 auth-session hardening (code + design, deploy BLOCKED) and section 9 private authenticated Download-receipt. Implement the backend-owned opaque HttpOnly-cookie session/BFF design with CSRF, single-flight refresh and idle/absolute expiry (settings validated against the app client, NOT deployed); assert the seven exact section 6 error strings in the sign-in UI; and add the authenticated bounded-expiry private Download-receipt reusing the invoice-engine design. Cognito app-client live inspection and all deploys are BLOCKED (no AWS).
steps: Author the backend-owned customer session code: an opaque session id in a Secure, HttpOnly, host-only cookie with server-side Cognito token custody; CSRF protection for cookie-authenticated mutations; single-flight refresh with cross-tab coordination and bounded retry; server-enforced 7-day idle + 30-day absolute expiry where successful refresh does NOT extend the absolute deadline. Keep cart presentation data separate from credentials. Do NOT move refresh/access tokens into localStorage/sessionStorage. Record that live Cognito app-client inspection (rotation vs REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH / GetTokensFromRefreshToken) and deployment are BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT. Do NOT modify the Cognito user pool (UpdateUserPool is a full replace; see aws-agent-rules).

Update src/lib/customerAuth.ts and the sign-in flow to use the backend session where same-origin, with a tested client registration boundary; keep the generic delivery error semantics. Add vitest cases asserting the SEVEN exact section 6 strings verbatim: 'Include your country code, like +91.', 'Enter a valid number.', 'Couldn't send a code. Check your number.', 'Try again shortly.', 'Check your code.', 'Code expired. Send a new one.', 'Wait before trying again.' and that no red validation state is used and no token/OTP is placed in a URL or log.

Add an authenticated, owner-authorized Download-receipt route + handler that generates/serves from the immutable verified paid snapshot via the existing invoice-engine HTML/PNG/PDF design, with bounded-expiry signed links, cross-customer denial, and idempotent regeneration. Note deploy/S3 steps as BLOCKED. Add pytest for authorization/expiry/idempotency and cross-customer denial.
Run full gates: pytest, vitest, tsc, build.
acceptance_criteria: The seven section-6 error strings are asserted verbatim in a passing vitest test with no red computed style
The session design code enforces idle+absolute expiry server-side and never writes tokens to web storage (test-asserted where feasible)
Download-receipt enforces authorization, bounded expiry, cross-customer denial and idempotent regeneration (pytest-asserted)
All gates green: pytest 0 failed, vitest 0 failed, tsc clean, npm run build exit 0
findings:
Implemented code + design + IaC-authoring + tests only; all AWS deploy/live-inspection steps are BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT (no AWS credentials) and recorded with exact unblock commands.

FILES ADDED:
- amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/customer_session.py: backend-owned opaque session. Opaque id (256-bit CSPRNG) returned once for a Secure;HttpOnly;host-only;SameSite=Lax cookie; only its sha256 hash is stored. Server-side Cognito token custody by REFERENCE (never the token). CSRF double-submit (hmac.compare_digest). Single-flight refresh via a conditional lease claim with bounded retry (MAX_REFRESH_ATTEMPTS). Server-enforced 7-day idle + 30-day absolute expiry; a successful refresh slides idle but NEVER moves the absolute anchor. Non-persistent (shared-device) sessions get a short absolute cap and a session cookie. rotate() swaps the id after auth without resetting the absolute anchor. revoke() on sign-out is idempotent. A DEFINITE refresh failure (spent token -> RefreshFailed) revokes; a TRANSIENT one (offline/5xx -> RefreshUnavailable) does NOT log out. Pure module: injected store + injected cognito_refresh + injected clock, no boto, no network.
- amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/customer_session_config.py: IaC/config as data (NOT deployed). REQUIRED_APP_CLIENT_SETTINGS (CUSTOM_AUTH preserved, ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH added, short access-token validity, 30-day refresh validity, PreventUserExistenceErrors ENABLED), REQUIRED_SESSION_TABLE (keyed on sidHash, SSE, TTL on absoluteExpiresAt as janitor only), refresh_flow_for() (rotation -> GetTokensFromRefreshToken, else REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH), UNBLOCK_COMMANDS, BLOCKED_ON_ENVIRONMENT note.
- amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/ecommerce/customer_receipt.py: authenticated owner-authorised private Download-receipt. Authorises via customer_auth.authorize_resource (cross-customer -> CustomerNotAuthorized, same as missing); renders from the immutable QuoteSnapshot (amounts from frozen integer-paise components, never recomputed); reuses the injected invoice-engine _build_invoice_html design; stores under media_paths.secure() (assert_private_key refuses any public/bag-icon key); deterministic key derived from snapshot hash + format => idempotent regeneration; bounded-expiry signed links via receipt_links.signed_url (ceiling enforced). S3 injected + mocked.
- src/lib/signInMessages.ts: the SEVEN section-6 strings verbatim in one auditable source + SECTION_6_MESSAGES; reserved NOT_ON_WHATSAPP kept out of the seven.
- tests/test_customer_session.py (33 cases), tests/test_customer_receipt.py (13 cases), src/test/SignInMessages.test.tsx (7 cases).

FILES MODIFIED:
- src/pages/account/sign-in.tsx: MSG table now references signInMessages constants (no re-typed copy). MISSING_CODE re-introduced as an AUDITABLE named constant but deliberately NOT wired to a reachable state (divided PhoneField always carries a dial code, so the missing-code state cannot occur; not forced to render). PhoneField/divided field preserved. No red validation state (lime #d1f470 / #1a3a2a treatment retained).

SEVEN-STRING TEST HONESTY: asserts all seven exist verbatim as approved constants (present + auditable), asserts reachable error states (BAD_CODE, RATE_LIMITED) render an approved string with no red, and asserts the error CSS block carries no red hue. MISSING_CODE checked for PRESENCE only, never forced into a code path.
